completedVisuals.message: Threats and surveillance restrict freedom to choose; explore options if safe
Care respects decisions; coercive control overrides choices
Free, informed, specific and changeable consent, with the original qualifications
Listen, inquire, validate, enhance safety and support; retain training and privacy limits
Recognize economic control and offer options without directing confrontation
Discuss safe communication and preferred support without assuming password changes are safe
Listen without demanding details and explain confidentiality limits
Calm school support and involvement of qualified safeguarding services through an approved process
Acknowledge threats and listen without imposing labels or decisions

reusableDecisions.style: Mature flat editorial artwork featuring Black African people in distinct everyday settings, with deep purple, lavender, golden yellow, teal, mint and soft blue.
reusableDecisions.pairedContinuity: Each supportive frame was edited from its situation image with the built-in image_gen tool, retaining character identities, clothing, setting, furniture and relevant props.
reusableDecisions.ratios: 4:3 teaching scenes, 3:2 header, object-fit contain throughout. Pairs stack below 681px without cropping.
reusableDecisions.loading: Header loads eagerly with high priority. Teaching scenes load lazily; every image reserves its dimensions and has contextual alternative text.
reusableDecisions.text: Chapter numbers, labels, headings, captions and diagrams remain editable website text. PNG and WebP artwork is raster, not vector.

verification.build: npm.cmd run build -- --outDir artifacts/gbv-chapter-01-refresh/production: passed, exit 0, including TypeScript. Vite emitted non-fatal React Router use-client directive warnings.
verification.regressions: npm.cmd test -- tests/gbv-learning.spec.ts: all 15 passed. Includes original content in Chapters 1–3, unchanged PDF downloads, navigation, five responsive widths, image-error fallback, privacy, contents tracking and print disclosure restoration.
verification.formatting: Prettier check passed for the changed source files, scripts and existing test file.
verification.browserReview: Passed at 320, 375, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920 pixels: all 18 sections and 13 illustrations, 522 text contrast checks, reserved image dimensions, uncropped scenes, no horizontal overflow, keyboard navigation and visible focus, optional disclosures, quick exit with its original history limitation, unchanged source hashes and no reflection storage or submissions. Quick-exit destination was mocked. Final report: after/review.json. Preview route returned HTTP 200.
verification.print: 22 pages, all 12 teaching scenes, no missing extracted text units, blank pages or text outside page boundaries. All pages rendered with bundled Poppler and visually reviewed. Original disclosure states were restored. Evidence: print/audit.json, print/overview-1.png and print/overview-2.png.
verification.baselineLimitation: Original comparison screenshots for other readers captured React's loading screen, so they are not valid pixel baselines. An attempted isolated source-snapshot server could not prebundle dependencies because Windows sandbox access to a parent directory was denied. Default-reader behavior, original photo scenes and current screenshots were checked instead, alongside the passing regression tests.
verification.concurrentEdits: Independent GBV library layout changes in gbv.css and whitespace-only formatting in mental-health.css were reviewed and preserved. Differences are recorded in the corresponding concurrent.patch artifacts; they were not authored by this chapter task.
verification.notRun: The complete project-wide test suite was not run. No lint script is configured. No new clinical, legal, safeguarding, localization or service-availability review is claimed.
